purpose: Optional evidence input for offline symbolic plan review

facts.subject: robot or an existing integer scene node ID
facts.predicate: predicate from the atomic skill library
facts.value: boolean, integer scene node ID, robot, or null as required by the predicate

trust_policy: A proposed skill effect is never accepted as an observed fact. Missing facts remain unknown. External observations must name a source and timestamp.
